findings.one_line: The promised complete Hölder--margin width frontier is replaced by an implicit one-sided occupation-relaxation lower bound: no explicit full-class branches or thresholds, and no law-independent attaining design and honest interval, are delivered.

The rho^(-1/2) fixed-gap result does not state its precise theorem-level distinction from the closest finite-arm regret--inference frontier (SimchiLeviWang2023BanditExperimentalDesign); under the proved global-sign reduction, non-subsumption must be made explicit rather than asserted in the comparator table.

Position every cited comparator with a relevance sentence: Armstrong2022ExperimentalDesignEfficiency and PraharajKhamaru2025AvoidingPriceAdaptivity appear in the bibliography but receive no substantive comparison to the proposed common-design honest-width frontier.
